C0110.title: Man Arrested for Operating Over 1,000 Phones to Manipulate Views and Comments
C0110.summary: In August 2023, the Economic Development Branch of the Anqing Public Security Bureau cracked a case involving illegal profit from fake traffic, arrested one suspect, dismantled one operating site, and seized 1,052 mobile phones. The suspect used more than a thousand phones in a rented room to manipulate live-stream rankings, inflate traffic, and control comments for profit.
